_about: Steve's hand per frame of plant_flag.png: [x, y] of the arm-tip pixel inside the 64x64 cell. The pole attaches here (pivot = pixel centre, so add 0.5). Hand-picked by Julia 2026-10-15; tests/boot_checks.gd fails if a point stops landing on an arm pixel (redrawn frame = re-pick). feet_row: the row under Steve's feet, so offset.y = -(feet_row - 32) = -11, same as steve.png.

pole_grip._about: Where the hand holds pole.png (32x32, a 2px vertical bar at x 16-17). spin: twirled around its middle. plant: held near the bottom so the tip drives into the ground on the last plant frame, then the waving flag replaces it (flag.png's pole base is at about (25, 31)).
